scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && uv lock --check --project services/model && uv sync --frozen --project services/model
scripts.test: bun run test:model && bun run test:contracts && bun run test:view-model && bun run test:web
scripts.dev:twin: bash scripts/build-twin.sh && HYDROCYCLE_WEB_MODE=hosted HYDROCYCLE_DEPLOY_TARGET=sites NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bun run --cwd apps/web next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 5186
scripts.test:cad:browser: bun run --cwd apps/web playwright test --config playwright.cad.config.ts
scripts.build:sites:static: HYDROCYCLE_WEB_MODE=hosted HYDROCYCLE_DEPLOY_TARGET=sites-static NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bun run --cwd apps/web next build
